summary: Australian Oilseeds Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the voluntary cancellation of PIPE warrants issued in two private placements during 2026. The board approved the Warrant Cancellation, Waiver and Release Agreement on August 26, 2026, under which holders surrender all PIPE warrants and release related claims. The cancellations remove potential overhang from up to 37.6 million underlying shares (2.0M warrants at $2.00 exercise and 16.8M at $0.70) but involve no payment or new securities. This is a routine warrant termination, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, or strategic action apply.
